acquisition method: The Orbitrap Velos was set to data‐dependent acquisition in positive ion mode
cleavage agent: proteins were digested overnight at 37°C and 700 rpm in a thermomixer using trypsin (Roche)
collision energy: fragmentation using higher‐energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at 30% normalised collision energy
enrichment method: quantify their expressed kinomes using Kinobeads
fractionation method: For hydrophilic strong anion exchange (hSAX) chromatography, peptide solutions were first dried down
fragmentation method: fragmentation using higher‐energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at 30% normalised collision energy
instrument: directly coupling an Eksigent nanoLC‐Ultra 1D+ (Eksigent) to an Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher)
labeling: kinomes were quantified using the label‐free quantification (LFQ) intensities provided by MaxQuant
reduction reagent: 3.5 mg of TCL per sample was reduced with 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: 3.5 mg of TCL per sample was reduced with 10 mM DTT
